name: founden-mcp
description: Build and run a real company from your AI agent. Describe it in plain language; Founden builds the website, app, and admin in the cloud and returns a live link.
long_description: Founden is an AI company builder. Through one API key, your AI agent can start a build from a plain-language prompt, stream live progress, send follow-up instructions, and stop a build, all without keeping a browser open. The full product (website, customer app, admin dashboard) is built and deployed in the cloud and returned as a live link.

tools.name: build_company
tools.description: Start a Founden build from a plain-language prompt. Returns an execution_id and a stream URL.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Get build status and the live preview URL.

tools.name: message_build
tools.description: Send a follow-up instruction to a running build.
